description: Balanced, reproducible 10-image sample for the isolated structure total-span/total-height prefilter experiment. All image paths verified to exist under the main-bank root and to be catalogued in the letter bank (帮做_字母库) with a structure type. Only 梁/钢架/桁架 are included; 拱 and 组合结构 are excluded (arch needs computed height; combined structures are counted as 钢架 in the letter bank). No answer images.
